1.content: - Prioritize moves that reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal 'G', assigning higher values to moves that bring the agent closer to 'G' in row+column terms. Strongly penalize moves that lead back to positions visited within the last 3 steps to prevent oscillation and backtracking, unless all alternative forward paths are blocked by hazards; in cases of detected oscillation or lack of progress (e.g., revisiting states repeatedly), boost ratings for unexplored moves toward the goal, even if riskier. Penalize repeated moves along the same row or column without net progress toward the goal, indicating local dead-ends. Boost ratings for downward or rightward moves that open new paths when stuck with limited options.
